text:
Olivia (Partnerships): Heads-up: Nebula Systems wants a co-marketing kit for their cloud marketplace launch—includes 1 quickstart card, 2 sticker sizes (laptop + seal), and a one-page solution brief. Need final assets & legal copy by Tuesday to hit their print run.
Noah (Design): Uploaded initial mockups: https://drive.redwood/nebula/kit_v1.pdf. Quick notes: recommend horizontal lockup for card, laptop sticker 60x18mm, seal 38mm circle. Will add dielines once legal confirms spacing.
Olivia (Partnerships): @Sam can Nebula place their reseller badge next to ours on the card? Also any mandatory trademark footers?
Sam (Legal): They may, provided our mark is untouched and the proximity doesn't imply endorsement. Required footer copy: "Redwood Inference and the Redwood logo are trademarks of Redwood Labs, Inc. Used under license." Also: no "powered by" language that suggests integration without our approval. Send final mock for sign-off.
Priya (Marketing): For the marketplace tile we need hero 1200x628, square 800x800, and thumbnail 400x240. Suggested headline: "Redwood + Nebula: cloud-grade LLM inference". Alt text: "Nebula rack with Redwood badge".
Ken (HW PM): Printer needs print-ready PDFs with 3mm bleed by Tue 5pm PT. Confirm adhesive spec for box seal: high-temp shipping friendly. I can hold the print slot if assets are on time.
AssetBot: Attached: nebula-brand-guidelines-2026.pdf, nebula-reseller-badge.eps
Noah (Design): Small design question: Nebula requests equal-weight logos. Recommend side-by-side with 1px divider, but we prefer slight visual priority for Redwood. Mocking both options now.
Sam (Legal): Also flag: Nebula asked to use phrase "certified for Redwood Inference" on their product page. That's OK with the line: "Certification indicates compatibility and not endorsement." Add that to the brief.
Priya (Marketing): Case brief draft: "Redwood reduces latency and cost on Nebula cloud appliances via batching and KV caching." Remove specific percentages until validated.
Olivia (Partnerships): Timeline recap: 1) Noah -> final PDFs + marketplace crops by Tue 3pm PT; 2) Sam -> legal sign-off on mock by Tue 6pm PT; 3) Priya -> final copy + alt text by Tue 2pm PT; 4) Ken -> confirm pickup once PDFs are final. If anyone needs more time flag now.
Noah (Design): Will deliver PDFs by Tue 2pm PT.
Sam (Legal): I'll aim to review mock by Tue 5pm PT.
Ken (HW PM): Slot reserved Tue-Wed pending sign-off.
Olivia (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll post final checklist and vendor PO when legal signs off.
